title: errorMessage
responsibility: Converts thrown values to readable messages without changing their text.

inputs.name: errorMessage.cause
inputs.description: The JavaScript value whose readable message is returned. It may be any value, including null or undefined.

outputs.name: errorMessage
outputs.description: The returned message is Error.message for Error instances and String(cause) otherwise. Errors during message access or string conversion propagate unchanged.

errors.name: Message access or conversion error
errors.description: An arbitrary value thrown while reading Error.message or converting a non-Error cause with String(cause). The helper does not catch or change it.
